entities.summary: Joseph Constantine Carpue was an English surgeon who was born in London. He was associated with St George's Hospital and Duke of York Hospital in Chelsea. In addition to being known as a skilled surgeon, he was a popular lecturer of anatomy. Joseph Constantine Carpue was a scientists & inventors from United Kingdom (1764-05-04–1846-01-30).
